hook: Albert Gu is one of the two authors of Mamba, the 2023 paper that showed a state space model could match Transformer-quality language modeling while scaling linearly instead of quadratically with sequence length. The work built on his earlier S4 research from his Stanford PhD under Chris Re, and it gave the field its first credible architectural alternative to attention. Gu now holds both an academic and a commercial base for that idea, teaching as an Assistant Professor in Carnegie Mellon's Machine Learning Department while serving as Chief Scientist and Co-Founder at Cartesia, a startup applying state space models to real-time voice and audio AI. TIME named him to its 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024 for that combination of research and applied work.
